about: Escape the menu: nine pre-launch Reels (made by social/reels/escape.mjs from each post's frames, with an original ticking-clock soundtrack), 26 Sep to 4 Oct 2026 (days -8 to 0 before START_DATE 2026-10-05), 8:30 pm. Each: an exaggerated diner problem, then a riddle about Lahore food whose answer gives one letter of the 10-letter code. From 4 Oct 8:30 pm the first 5 correct DMs win. Prize venue not confirmed yet: confirm before announcing winners.

posts.caption:
Room 1. You walked in hungry. You trusted a photo. The photo lied, and now you are locked in with the consequences.

The only way out is a 10-letter code. One riddle a night. Tonight's gives you letter 4.

ESCAPE THE MENU: one riddle a night until 4 October. Every answer gives one letter of a 10-letter code (the chili box tells you which letter, the board tells you where it goes). DMs count from 4 October, 8:30 pm. The first 5 people to DM @eatmenva the code win a premium dine-in on us, a private after party and MENVA Black free as founding members.

Rules: Lahore only, 18+, one entry per account. The code only counts if you DM it after 4 October, 8:30 pm. Winners are announced on our Story and contacted by DM from @eatmenva only; we will never ask for money or card details. Venue and date are shared with the winners. Run by MENVA, not sponsored, endorsed or run by Instagram.

We have a way out. DM us "secret".
